title: The lotus pond awakens
summary: Pink, gold and lilac lotus flowers open above a small jade pond.
prompt: In Polynite, create an editable Japanese garden study: Pink, gold and lilac lotus flowers open above a small jade pond. Compose existing operators as data recipes; keep relationships, materials and exposed parameters editable. Use the linked scene as a reference, invent your own variation, and preserve the current scene.
try: Compare ivory slender petals and a rose lotus with generous layers.
Set animate to 0, then drag opening. Set animate to 1 and Play for the six-second loop.
Change petals, layers, petal_width and colours to compose a new flower.
steps: Compose shared geometry and material operators from the recipe JSON.
Bind explicit supports or paths where needed, retaining stable IDs.
Expose parameters; verify changes, relationships and playback before saving.
settings: Open & test > Variant for presets; Adjust for recipe parameters. Scene settings > Living architecture exposes the same inputs. Support and path relationships are stored in the downloadable scene/recipe JSON.
limits: Stylised procedural study. Explicit analytic cube supports and flat named paths; no arbitrary terrain fitting or roof unions. Animation articulates cached petals; landscape changes occur at edit time.
